Beam 2.0.3: play Android games on your computer over Wi-Fi, on **Windows and Mac**.

## Downloads

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** 10/11 (64-bit) | [Beam-2.0.3-Windows-Setup.exe](https://github.com/Limboo369/widex/releases/download/v2.0.3/Beam-2.0.3-Windows-Setup.exe) |
| **Mac** with Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4...) | [Beam-2.0.3-macOS-AppleSilicon.dmg](https://github.com/Limboo369/widex/releases/download/v2.0.3/Beam-2.0.3-macOS-AppleSilicon.dmg) |
| **Mac** with an Intel processor | [Beam-2.0.3-macOS-Intel.dmg](https://github.com/Limboo369/widex/releases/download/v2.0.3/Beam-2.0.3-macOS-Intel.dmg) |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu > About This Mac: "Chip: Apple M..." means Apple Silicon, "Processor: Intel" means Intel.

**Opening Beam on a Mac the first time:** the app is not signed by Apple, so right-click Beam in Applications and choose **Open**. On macOS 15 or later, if you only see "Done", go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.

## What's new

- New step-by-step phone setup guide: it opens on first launch and walks you through Developer options, USB or wireless debugging, the permission prompt on the phone and the Windows driver
- The guide checks the connection live at each step and shows how to fix the most common problems
- Open it again any time from Help, the Beam menu or the Connect window
